description: This file contains the implementation of the TaxClass controller within the Opencart administration panel. It manages CRUD operations for tax classes, including listing, adding, editing, and deleting tax class entries, with support for pagination, sorting, and validation.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing tax classes in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting tax class records.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for listing and rendering the taxonomy page with pagination, sorting, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all tax classes with a call to getList() and outputs the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of tax classes, including sorting, filtering, pagination, and generating links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and renders the form for adding or editing a tax class, populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a tax class based on posted form data, with permission checks and JSON responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected tax classes, including permission checks and response handling.
